crossRefs.note: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go…
Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am…
If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be…
Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory, which you…
Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek Yahweh; but they won’t find him. He has withdrawn himself…
For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’ ”
“Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.
When once the master of the house has risen up, and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at…
“Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather…
Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in…
He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you…
They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,

translations.web: You will seek me, and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”
translations.bsb: You will look for Me, but you will not find Me; and where I am, you cannot come.”
translations.kjv: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.
translations.asv: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, ye cannot come.
